# Bundled webfonts

IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono, subset to Latin and served from this
directory so the documentation renders identically offline and makes no
third-party request when read.

| Family | Weights |
|---|---|
| IBM Plex Sans | 400, 400 italic, 500, 600, 700 |
| IBM Plex Mono | 400, 600 |

Copyright © 2017 IBM Corp., licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 —
see [`OFL.txt`](OFL.txt). The `.woff2` builds come from the
[Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) distribution of the upstream
[IBM/plex](https://github.com/IBM/plex) release.
